sections.title: Science across boundaries
sections.body:
I am part of the team that developed and coordinates the **BonaRes LTE Overview Map**, an international geospatial infrastructure documenting long-term agricultural experiments. My work spans LTE metadata harmonisation, FAIR data management and knowledge infrastructures, and the use of GIS and GeoAI to understand how representative our experimental evidence is of the world's agricultural landscapes.

I collaborate across GLTEN, LTAR, EJP SOIL and SoilWise to connect experimental networks with the people who need their evidence — researchers, living labs and policy makers. [Add a sentence on your current position and key achievements.]
